ParrainageCode.label: Codes de Parrainage
ParrainageCode.schema: CREATE TABLE parrainage_codes (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL, user_id INT DEFAULT NULL, email VARCHAR(250) DEFAULT NULL, commission_percent DECIMAL(5, 2) DEFAULT 0.00, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

ParrainageReferral.label: Filleuls
ParrainageReferral.schema: CREATE TABLE parrainage_referrals (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, code_id INT NOT NULL, referred_user_id INT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (code_id) REFERENCES parrainage_codes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
